page_title: FUL 2-1 ARS | Fulham v Arsenal 31/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Bernd Leno (Fulham) is booked by the referee.
90+6' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
90+6' Arsenal take a short corner kick.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Arsenal. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.

90+5' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
90+3' Substitution. Harrison Reed (Fulham) in, Tom Cairney out.
90+2' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Raul Jimenez (Fulham).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

89' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) unleashes a brilliant effort from the free kick, but the ball crashes against the bar. What a chance!
86' Joshua Smith shows a yellow card to William Saliba (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
84' A first-time shot by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
81' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempts to find Gabriel, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
80' Arsenal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
79' Substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) makes way for Harry Wilson.
79' Here comes a substitution. Willian (Fulham) is given a rest as he is replaced by Issa Diop.
79' Declan Rice (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
77' Here is a change. Kai Havertz is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Reiss Nelson (Arsenal).
77' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
74' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
72' Substitution. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has come on for Alex Iwobi.
72' Tom Cairney (Fulham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but David Raya was alert and made a comfortable save.
67' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) replacing Ben White.
67' Today's match ends for Gabriel Martinelli who will be replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
67' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
66' Arsenal are awarded the free kick.
65' Tom Cairney (Fulham) is given a yellow card.
64' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
59' 2 - 1 The attempt by Joao Palhinha is blocked, but from the middle of the box Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) hits the rebound into the top of the net. He alters the score to 2:1.
59' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
59' Willian (Fulham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

53' The cross into the penalty area from Ben White (Arsenal) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
50' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' The ball is cleared after Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Fulham will take a corner kick.
48' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Mikel Arteta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jakub Kiwior. He is replaced by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Declan Rice (Arsenal) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.

45+2' What a miss! Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
43' CHANCE! Martin Odegaard finds Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
40' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' A cross by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
35' 46:54 – the latest ball possession ratio.
33' William Saliba (Arsenal) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
32' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Bukayo Saka.
31' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Joshua Smith blows his whistle for a foul.

29' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Tom Cairney. The score is now 1:1.
28' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to find Kai Havertz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
24' David Raya (Arsenal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
23' David Raya (Arsenal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
22' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
22' Willian (Fulham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
22' A nice individual effort by Willian (Fulham) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
19' Willian (Fulham) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
17' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
17' Joshua Smith blows his whistle and it's Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
15' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by David Raya.
14' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Raul Jimenez (Fulham) heads on.
12' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alex Iwobi (Fulham).
12' Gabriel (Arsenal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Joshua Smith signals.
10' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bernd Leno, who smothers the ball.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
5' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.

3' The opposition back off Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
2' Arsenal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Arsenal will kick-off.
Joshua Smith will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
